verdicts.title: Algebraic theta functions and Eisenstein-Kronecker numbers
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: In this paper, we give an overview of our previous paper concerning the investigation of the algebraic and $p$-adic properties of Eisenstein-Kronecker numbers using Mumford's theory of algebraic theta functions.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract discusses algebraic theta functions and Eisenstein-Kronecker numbers, with no mention of Boolean functions, communication complexity, or root separability of varieties associated with Boolean functions.

verdicts.title: Simultaneous approximation by conjugate algebraic numbers in fields of transcendence degree one
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We present a general result of simultaneous approximation to several transcendental real, complex or p-adic numbers xi_1,...,xi_t by conjugate algebraic numbers of bounded degree over Q, provided that the given transcendental numbers xi_1,...,xi_t generate over Q a field of transcendence degree one.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract discusses 'simultaneous approximation to several transcendental real, complex or p-adic numbers by conjugate algebraic numbers,' which concerns Diophantine approximation, not communication complexity of Boolean functions or root separability of varieties associated with them.
